subject: Post-call recap: Scout Health pilot — SDK scope, streaming, function-calls, rerank
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@scouthealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-21T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Scout Health pilot — SDK scope, streaming, function-calls, rerank

Hi Lena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we all have the same picture.

Pain points you highlighted:
- Clinical search returns too many low-relevance passages (long EHR notes).
- Latency spikes when staff run batch searches during morning rounds.
- Need structured triage output (discrete fields) for downstream systems.

Goals for the pilot:
1) Replace current keyword search for triage to improve top-5 relevance (expect +20–30% precision uplift).
2) Deliver streaming responses for long patient dialogs so UI can show partial results.
3) Structured function-calls (diagnosis_hint, urgency_score, followup_recommendation) so you can integrate into care workflows.
4) Keep PII controls and audit logs (SOC2-compatible) — we’ll outline options below.

Technical fit / SDK asks we discussed:
- Embeddings + reranker flow: we recommend embedding candidate chunks (512-d) and running a small cross-encoder rerank on the top N.
- Streaming & partial outputs: Redwood SDK will provide a streaming client that emits partial JSON-compatible segments; UI can render incrementally.
- Function-calls & structured outputs: propose a stable JSON schema for the 3 function types above. SDK will include a schema validator and examples.
- Latency/cost trade-offs: for pilot, suggest quantized model variant for rerank (reduced cost) and a higher-quality hosted variant for final ranking.

Proposed deliverables/milestones:
- Week 1 (this week): share scoped MVP requirements and sample schema (attached: scout_mvp-requirements.xlsx).
- Week 2: engineering deep-dive (devs + infra) to confirm SDK hooks and streaming contract.
- Week 4: pilot environment (staging VPC) + security checklist.
- Pilot start: target early Jan 2026 (TBD after procurement).

Open items for Scout:
- Confirm whether procurement/legal needs SOC 2 Type II evidence or additional attestation.
- Provide a small sample dataset or anonymized notes to validate rerank tuning (can be synthetic).

Next steps I’ll take:
- Share a short technical proposal + rough SOW for the pilot (attached: redwood-sdk-proposal.pdf).
- Schedule the engineering deep-dive — propose Wed Nov 26 10:00 AM PT.

Can you confirm the meeting time and whether legal/procurement should be looped in now?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0199
www.redwood.com

Attachments:
- scout_mvp-requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet — fields: sample schema, success metrics, dataset notes)
- redwood-sdk-proposal.pdf (proposal, pilot scope, and pricing ranges)

From: Lena Park <lena.park@scouthealth.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Scout Health Procurement <procurement@scouthealth.ai>
Date: 2025-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Scout Health pilot — SDK scope, streaming, function-calls, rerank

Thanks Tessa — really clear write-up, appreciate it. A few quick confirmations from our side: 

- Pilot priorities: agree with the four goals; improving top-5 relevance and structured triage are highest priority.
- Security/compliance: Procurement will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and our security team will want to review VPC options and KMS integration. Please include any SOC2 artifacts in the next package.
- Timeline: procurement bandwidth is light in Dec; our target is to sign SOW + kick off staging by the second week of January and start pilot the week of Jan 5–9.
- Legal/procurement: looping procurement on this thread (they’re cc’d). For contracting, they typically ask for an 8–12 week SLA review; a short pilot SOW is preferred.

On dataset: we can produce a small set of 200 anonymized encounter notes for tuning, currently working with our privacy team. I’ll confirm by end of week.

One ask: could you include a short, one-page security summary (SOC2, data residency, encryption in transit & at rest) and a rough price band for a 3-month pilot? Procurement wants to see ballpark numbers before the SOW draft.

If Wed Nov 26 10:00 AM PT works for engineering, confirm and we’ll calendar it — I’ll include a security engineer and procurement rep.

Best,
Lena Park
Head of Product — Clinical AI | Scout Health
lena.park@scouthealth.ai
